text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after the Unity Cup and the
Twinkle
Series have both wrapped up,
Director Akikawa
summons our team.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well done on getting through all the ups
and
downs life has thrown at you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And more importantly, congratulations
on
winning the Unity Cup! Those were
some truly
moving, riveting, and most
wonderful races!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It was quite the treat watching you sprint
toward
victory, fueled by all the
teamwork you've
cultivated!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was holding their breaths as
they
watched your bout against Team
Zenith. Surely it
is safe to say that
everyone was blown away!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The strength of your team is truly
commendable.
Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As a special reward, allow me to present
to you a
voucher for a free carrot BBQ
to use now that
things have settled
down!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing your future
growth and
performance!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To you illustrious Umamusume, I present
this
bonus reward!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As your team name is Blue Bloom, I
thought it
only appropriate to reward
you with a beautiful
flower-themed gift!

You obtained:
<itemname>!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! It's a vintage brooch I picked up
in New
York called the Radiant Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you... so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Receiving such a wonderful reward raises
our
team's spirit higher than ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Everyone got your glass ready?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Cheeers!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Cheeers!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: This is so good!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It really is! Oh, we've still got a ton of
carrots to
go around!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Three cheers for Director Akikawa! How
blessed
we are.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! I can't believe we get to have a
BBQ on
the beach—talk about paradise!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And it's even better 'cause I'm
surrounded by all
of y'all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gettin' to celebrate the three years
we've worked
together sure is somethin'
else! All these
memories're rushin' back
to me as we speak!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes. It's making me feel so warm and
fluffy...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What's warm and fluffy now? Are you
talking
about dessert? If so, I want some!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I think she's being metaphorical, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my team enjoying themselves so

thoroughly, I can't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still remember how Rice Shower
stopped coming
to practice, and how
they got challenged by
Team Zenith to
an unofficial race...
choice_data_list: (Things were really tough in the beginning...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've overcome a lot together in these
three
years while confronting the
challenges presented
by the team
competition.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What's got you so deep in
thought?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You'd better snap out of it before
there's nothin'
left to eat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The party's just beginnin', so I hope
you're
hungry!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Here, Trainer! I got some carrot juice for
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-oh dear, but I brought some too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You did?! Haha! I guess it's double
servings of
carrot juice for Trainer, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, a familiar group shows up.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Fancy meeting you here! Did you guys
get a
voucher for this carrot BBQ as
well?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm guessin' y'all got one too,
then?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Yup. The director said it was a reward
for all our
hard work!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I doubt that's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Hello. It's been a while, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa was singing your
praises when
she handed us our voucher.
She has high
expectations for you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I must admit I was a mite jealous, but
that's fine.
I'm the type who enjoys a
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm a trainer, we've become
proper
rivals. I look forward to facing
you in the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The road stretches ever onward before
us.
<chrname> and I promise
to keep
putting our best foot forward!
